verdict.rationale: Guidance text on dos.ny.gov (incorporation, Division of Corporations, and forming-a-corporation pages) was retrieved verbatim, and probes of the same host got ordinary HTTP 404 responses rather than a challenge, so the main reading surface appears open to a keyless agent. However, no probe directly records an HTTP 200 for a guidance page under a standard identified user agent. The adjacent filing host reset the connection, and Business Express disallows all crawling in robots.txt, so not every public state surface is agent-reachable. missing for 10: an explicit probe confirming HTTP 200 server-rendered guidance pages under an identified UA with no CAPTCHA or JS shell, independent corroboration, and an open companion filing/Business Express surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
